No masterclass

Your biggest reels have nowhere to land

Reels at 90.9k and 99k views reach well past your followers. Someone who isn’t ready for 8 weeks of coaching can take the quiz, but there’s no moment where they spend an hour with you and start to trust you.

Toolkit hidden

The $47 toolkit waits to be found

It sits in your link in bio. Nothing puts it in front of people at the moment they’re most motivated, straight after they’ve just learned something from you.

No ads

Every lead depends on today’s post

All your demand comes from organic reach. There’s no way to turn ad spend into sign-ups, toolkit sales and clarity calls on a predictable schedule.

Your content already does the hard part. There’s just nothing between a great reel and an 8-week commitment.

Sound familiar?

You know the theory. Your attachment system still takes over.

  • One slow reply and your whole evening goes to checking your phone.
  • You ask for space, then wonder if you’ve just avoided the repair.
  • You can name your attachment style, but you can’t switch it off mid-argument.
  • You set a boundary, and it comes out sounding like a rule.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why knowing your style isn’t enough

What actually happens when your attachment system takes over, and why insight alone doesn’t stop it.

The one question for when you’re triggered

How to use “What would secure me do?” in the moment, not just afterwards.

Taking space vs. avoiding repair

How to step back without leaving the other person wondering if you’re coming back.

Boundaries vs. rules

The difference between protecting your wellbeing and trying to control someone else.

Healing happens by staying present

A simple practice for staying with the feeling long enough to choose a secure response.

Meet Jessica

Hi, I’m Jessica Da Silva

Before you save your seat

Is this for individuals or couples?

Both. Most people come on their own, and you’re welcome to watch with your partner.

What if I can’t make it live?

Register anyway. You’ll get the replay for 48 hours.

Is this therapy?

No. It’s an educational coaching class with practical tools. It isn’t therapy and doesn’t replace working with a licensed professional.

Is it really free?

Yes. Come, learn the tools, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper.

A lot of people tell me they already know their attachment style. They’ve done the quiz, read the books, listened to the podcasts.

That’s what my 1:1 coaching is for: over 8 weeks, using the My Secure Self Method®, on your own or as a couple.

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Ad scripts for the masterclass

Three talking-to-camera scripts, each 30 to 45 seconds, filmed the way you already film your reels.

Script 1 · “I know my style”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“You know your attachment style. So why does one slow reply still take over your whole night?”

Body

“Because knowing your pattern and changing it in the moment are two different skills. The first one happens when you’re calm. The second one has to happen when you’re triggered, and that’s the part most of us were never taught.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it in a free live class called What Would Secure Me Do? Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “knowing ≠ changing”.

Script 2 · “Space or avoidance?”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Is it taking space, or is it avoiding repair?”

Body

“Taking space sounds like: ‘I need a minute, can we talk at eight?’ Avoiding repair is leaving and hoping it just disappears. One calms the loop down. The other keeps the anxious-avoidant cycle going.”

CTA

“In my free class I’ll show you how to take space without leaving the repair behind. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, split-screen text with the two columns in lavender and black.

Script 3 · “One question”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“This is the question I ask myself when I’m triggered.”

Body

“I understand how secure relationships work. I practise it. And I’m still human. So when my attachment system kicks in, I don’t try to win the moment. I ask: what would secure me do? Then I do the next small thing.”

CTA

“I’m teaching how to use it in a free live class. Seats are free. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, warm natural light, end card with the class title.
